recommended_pilot.title: Controls-first pilot: decision support
recommended_pilot.rationale: High value but high unmanaged-authority risk — adopt only once the required controls are in place. Stand up the controls, then pilot.

required_controls.control: Purpose & scope check at the action boundary (Purpose Permission™)
required_controls.why: Bind every consequential action to a declared purpose before it runs (§12).

required_controls.control: Evidence Pack™ sealed per consequential action
required_controls.why: Make every decision replay-provable for audit, regulator, or dispute (§13).

required_controls.control: Human oversight envelope (in-/over-the-loop) sized to the risk tier
required_controls.why: Match human control to the authority the AI holds (§36 GovernedUI).

required_controls.control: Data-use minimisation + access controls on the data it touches
required_controls.why: Govern personal / special-category data at the moment of use (§31).

required_controls.control: Regulatory-obligation mapping for the decision domain
required_controls.why: Identify which obligations bind this use before it goes live (an abstract role you will also need).

required_controls.control: Controls-architecture pass from obligations to enforced controls
required_controls.why: Translate obligations into the concrete controls your architecture must enforce (an abstract role you will also need).
